intent_en: To illustrate that a majority of Uber drivers earn less than minimum wage, while most also have other primary sources of income.
notes: The chart visualizes the percentage of drivers earning below minimum wage and those with other income, supporting the narration's points about low wages and supplementary employment.
narration_support: less than minimum wage for 54 % of drivers
chart_support: Two pie charts labeled '<MIN WAGE' and 'OTHER INCOME' show the pink segment occupying more than 50% of the circle in both cases, visually representing the majority (54% and ~60%) respectively.
